about: The components of liveMd2Tex's own TeX engine (engine.wasm and engine.js, built by engine/build/ from TeX Live's source), with each one's licence and notice files. Written for the engine release; it replaces engine/engine-notices.json when the extension ships this engine. The engine as a whole can be passed on under GPL-3.0 (xpdf allows GPL-2.0 or GPL-3.0 and no later version); our own code is GPL-3.0-or-later; every part keeps its own terms.

scripts.note: the public commit and tree hash from the CI build's engine-build.json

linked: engine/engine-build.json, linkMap.parts: every input of the link map belongs to one component by engine/build/tools/link-report.mjs's LINK_PARTS, and the build fails on an input none claims. Each component's links are those patterns, relative to the build root ('*' is any characters but '/'; an archive stands for every member the link takes from it).

search.about: The search of the linked libraries' compiled sources for licence clauses (the licence gates, F2-M1 to L5-01), an aid to reading, not a proof: scripts/engine-notice-search.mjs reads the four archives of 'sources' and checks every file below each folder for the patterns of 'clauses'. It guarantees that every clause matching a pattern, on one line or across two adjacent lines, is either covered by one of the folder's own licences that may cover that kind of clause ('own': the clause kinds it covers, its words, and the notice files that hold it; the notice files must name every holder on the copyright lines up to 25 lines above the clause, unless 'reference' or 'anyHolder' says otherwise, and those two hold only in their own words on the clause's own line), or its file is named by a rule a person wrote. Not seen, and so for the person's reading: words no pattern knows, a clause split over three lines or more, a holder more than 25 lines above its clause, a denial of a dedication in other words than the guard's, and a second author's grant of the same kind with no copyright line of its own. On every change of the engine pin, a person reads the new hits (--since engine/engine-notice-search.report.json, the recorded run) and the problems, and writes the rules, before a release (docs/DEVELOPING.md, 'When the engine pin changes').
search.run: node scripts/engine-notice-search.mjs --archives DIR [--since engine/engine-notice-search.report.json] [--report FILE], with DIR holding the archives of 'sources' by their names
